launches.title: Miniloop — AI GTM teammates for startups
launches.tagline: Run outbound, follow-up, content, and ops without hiring.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re building Miniloop: an AI workforce platform that helps startups run GTM without hiring a full GTM team.

### TL;DR

**Miniloop lets startups hire AI GTM teammates that run outbound, follow up with leads, create content, qualify signups, update CRM/spreadsheets, and execute repetitive workflows across tools like Gmail, Apollo, HubSpot, Google Sheets, Slack, and LinkedIn.**

Most early-stage founders know they should be doing outbound, following up with leads, writing content, qualifying signups, updating spreadsheets, and keeping prospects warm.

The problem is that all of this work is repetitive, tool-heavy, and easy to drop when you’re also building product and talking to customers.

Miniloop lets you hire AI agents that learn your business, connect to your tools, and run those workflows continuously.

The goal: help founders and small teams run GTM consistently without hiring more people.

### Launch video

<https://youtu.be/NruQjXiSUZ8>

### What Miniloop does

Miniloop agents can run GTM workflows like:

* finding and enriching leads
* writing and sending personalized outbound
* following up with signups
* qualifying prospects
* creating blog and SEO content
* updating spreadsheets and CRMs
* sending internal reports and alerts

They work across tools like Apollo, Gmail, HubSpot, Google Sheets, LinkedIn, Slack, and more.

The goal is simple: give founders and small GTM teams the output of extra teammates without adding headcount.

We’ve been using Miniloop internally for our own GTM, including blog generation, lead collection, and signup follow-up — workflows that map directly to your current dogfooding setup.

### Why now

Early-stage startups used to scale GTM by hiring more people.

Now the best teams can stay smaller longer.

Instead of duct-taping together brittle automations, Miniloop gives you agents that understand context, run multi-step workflows, and ask for help only when needed.

### Who it’s for

Miniloop is especially useful if you’re:

* a founder doing marketing / gtm work yourself
* a small team without dedicated GTM headcount
* running outbound, content, lead routing, or follow-up manually
* spending too much time moving data between tools

### Ask

We’re working closely with YC companies and doing hands-on workflow setup for early users.

If you’re running GTM or ops and want help automating the repetitive parts, happy to set it up with you.

Also grateful for intros to teams that are doing lots of manual GTM work across too many tools.
